name: Nevada
permitAge: 15 and a half (instruction permit); driver education not required for the permit

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night, logged on form DLD-130
teen.nightLimit: Licensed drivers under 18: no driving 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. unless going to or from a scheduled event (NRS 483, DMV form DP-038)
teen.passengerLimit: First six months after licensing: no passengers under 18 except immediate family (DMV form DP-038)
teen.phone: All drivers: no handheld phone for calls (hands-free allowed), no texting or internet use (NRS 484B.165). Fines $50 / $100 / $250 within seven years, doubled in work zones.

notes: Permit valid one year. Supervisor: licensed, at least 21, licensed at least one year, seated next to the beginner. Parent or guardian signs a financial responsibility statement.

Knowledge test: 25 multiple-choice questions, 80 percent (20 correct); stops at 20 correct or 6 incorrect; result valid one year; online test 60-minute limit (DMV wtestteens, dlquiz). Offered in English and Spanish.
Hold period for the permit before the license was not found in this search budget; holdPermit left null.
Under-21 0.02 to 0.08: NRS 483.461 and form DP-038 say 90-day suspension; the handbook says 185-day revocation. Conflict, not used in questions.
Move over (NDOT): slow down and move to the far lane when possible for stopped emergency vehicles with lights; extended to NDOT vehicles and, from Oct. 1, 2017, any traffic incident.
School bus: on a highway divided by a physical barrier or dividing section, traffic on the other roadway need not stop (NRS 484B).
Maximum posted speed 80 mph on state highways (NRS 484B.613).
Spanish audio handbook exists (DMV news); Spanish PDF handbook URL not confirmed.
